statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (v : V) :
  LinearAlgebraGame.orthogonal v v ↔ v = 0
name: LinearAlgebraGame.ortho_self_zero
content:
`ortho_self_zero` is a proof that the only vector orthogonal to itself is the zero vector. If `v` is
a vector, `ortho_self_zero v` is a proof that `ortho v v ↔ v = 0`.
